notes.title: Update for HTC vive controller support
notes.content:
After the game was released, we received feedback from many players and updated the game in order to better the game experience.
After this update, the game will support the HTC vive control handle, come and experience it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620383/03567be197a52ac411d49116122306e11602a9ae.png[/img]
